Weekly pipeline (`run_weekly.py`) producing full and condensed summary PRs
Historical reporting with a custom date range
Org-agnostic design — works with any public GitHub organization
JSON data output for downstream dashboards and reporting
GitHub Ations workflow for automated weekly runs

commits.message:
Route the questionnaire by system id instead of acronym (#735)

* Route the questionnaire by fismasystemid instead of acronym

The acronym is free text, not unique, changes on rename, and may contain
a slash, so /questionnaire/<acronym> broke bookmarks and collided across
systems. The route now takes :fismasystemid, same key as the System Detail
page. Every link builder (dashboard icon, System Info, breadcrumbs,
in-survey nav) uses the id, and the location.state fallback from the #734
hotfix is gone. Legacy acronym links redirect to the id form when they
resolve to exactly one system; zero or several matches land on the
dashboard with the not-found warning.

Closes #732

* Drop dead acronym resolver, build questionnaire path from RouteIds

* Show the backend reason when a reactivate is refused for a taken acronym

* Address review: distinct /questionnaire/system/:id path and a systems-loaded flag

A digit-only acronym could be read as an id, so the id form now lives
under a static system segment and the legacy acronym route is a separate
route that only redirects. The page gates on a new fismaSystemsLoaded
context flag instead of an empty list, so a user with no active systems
still reaches the decommissioned lookup and not-found.
